content.text: 2026 World Baseball Classic: USA all players - complete listEvery USA player selected for baseball's World championship being staged in Tokyo, San Juan, Houston and Miami from 5-17 March.Picture by Chris Coduto/Getty ImagesBy Jo Gunston 03 March 2026 15:53 GMT+02 min readThe World Baseball Classic (WBC) is back with the 2026 edition getting underway on Thursday (5 March) and concluding 17 March. The USA is in Pool B with Brazil, Great Britain, Italy and Mexico, fielding a strong team in an effort to win back the title they secured in 2017. But who is in the squad looking to wrest back the title after narrowly losing out to Japan in the 2023 final?
